reproduction.rationale: The same AJILE12 Fig. 3E task retains all 12 participants, 50/70/90% whole-channel dropouts, five mask/RF-partition replicates and three RF fits: 144 original accuracy cells for fully observed, training-mean, deterministic neural-network and DDPM arms. The accepted software kernel adds a fifth candidate arm; its generated 540-fold panel checks are partial software evidence and do not authenticate source imputation, original predictions or complete reproduction. Paper marginal accuracy SD and notebook paired-gain SD remain an unresolved provenance disagreement. Original event/day identities, masks, RF partitions, source-native imputation and prediction lineage, full Table S1/Talukder comparisons, correlation/spectral and relevant OU companions, complete references and scientific criteria remain unresolved. No authenticated common original-data/full-panel manifest, independently executed submitted-analysis interface or granular-output verifier is bound. Each held-out case may expose only its permitted observed channels and mask over the original event window; hidden channels and movement/rest targets remain evaluator-only. Simultaneous multi-mask release or cross-case writable state can expose held-out channels. Matched paper+data and paper+data+author-code exposure, the pinned author code as the sole information addition, and cumulative access/resource budgets are not established. No protocol, execution receipt, readiness or scientific success follows from this identity binding. Reproduction must independently reconstruct the complete source finding and companion panel; the frozen 144 RF cells and eight printed summaries are a partial target inventory, not an executable full-panel finding contract or proof of reproduction. The four original arms remain the source scope; resolving the fifth candidate input is an interface concern, not a new primary.
